{{Redirect|Ads|the monsters|Abyssal demon|the weapon|Abyssal dagger(p++)}} {{External|rs|rsc=Anti dragon breath Shield|dw=Anti-Dragon Shield}} {{Infobox Item |name = Anti-dragon shield |image = [[File:Anti-dragon shield.png]] |release = [[23 September]] [[2001]] |update = Dragon quest online! |members = No |quest = [[Dragon Slayer I]] |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = This provides partial protection from dragonbreath attacks. |value = 20 |weight = 5.443 |exchange = Yes |id = 1540 }} [[File:Anti-dragon shield detail.png|left|150px]] The '''anti-dragon shield''' is an item given by [[Duke Horacio]] in [[Lumbridge Castle]] during the [[Dragon Slayer I]] [[quest]]. After the quest, the shield can be purchased from [[Oziach]], or obtained from [[Duke Horacio]] for free. It is tradeable, but can only be equipped if the player has started Dragon Slayer I. The anti-dragon shield mitigates the effects of [[dragonfire]], reducing the maximum hit of most dragon-breath attacks by roughly ~80%. It also prevents [[Elvarg]] from '''severely''' draining the player's combat stats. The effects of [[antifire potion]] stack with the anti-dragon shield; using both provides full protection from standard dragonfire attacks. The shield's [[melee]] and [[ranged]] defensive bonuses are similar to those of an [[iron sq shield]], but this shield also provides [[Magic]] defence and has no offensive penalties. This gives it some usefulness as an all-purpose shield and best-in-slot for free-to-play mages. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 7 |dslash = 9 |dcrush = 8 |dmagic = 2 |drange = 8 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = shield |image = [[File:Anti-dragon shield equipped male.png|180px]] |altimage = [[File:Anti-dragon shield equipped female.png|180px]] }} ==Upgrading== Using a [[hammer]] and [[anvil]], players with 90 [[Smithing]] (can be [[boost]]ed) can attach a [[draconic visage]] to an anti-dragon shield to create a [[dragonfire shield]]. Doing so grants 2,000 Smithing experience. Players without the required level can bring the components to [[Oziach]], who will assist in creating the shield for a payment of 1,250,000 [[coins]]. After [[Dragon Slayer II]] is complete, a [[Skeletal visage]] can be fused with the anti-dragon shield in a similar fashion, creating a [[Dragonfire ward]]. Both of these shields inherit the anti-dragon shield's properties in addition to having their own unique traits. ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Collecting anti-dragon shields}} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Anti-dragon shield}} ==Shop locations== {{Store locations list|Anti-dragon shield}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Anti-dragon shield}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 5 July 2018 |update = Game Integrity Changes: Dragonfire |change = Players are now required to have started Dragon Slayer I in order to use Anti-fire protection. }} {{Subject changes |date = 18 June 2007 |update = The Dragonfire Shield |change = The item was graphically updated with the rework of [[Dragon Slayer I]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 18 April 2005 |update = Desert Treasure |change = *The item was renamed from "Dragonfire shield" to "Anti-dragon shield". *The item's examine was changed from "''This shield is said to have magical properties against dragon flames.''" to "''This provides partial protection from dragon-breath attacks.''" }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Anti-dragon shield detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Anti-dragon shield detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Anti-dragon shield (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Anti-dragon shield.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
